classification_basis: Semantic classification of all supplied annotation queries, combined by exact vid; no visual verification of videos.
notes: Video IDs are copied exactly from the source vid field and identify QVHighlights video segments.
A video may appear in multiple substantive categories when its queries support multiple topics.
other_uncertain contains videos whose query text does not support one of the other topics.
The original train, validation and test membership is preserved.
Labels concern annotated topics and moments; they are not official category annotations or verified whole-video ground truth.
The presence of physical downloaded video files was not checked.
